chunks: This is the time of reaching the limit for us in selecting the chosen part of the speech of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him,
praising Allah, the Glorified, for what He bestowed upon us of enabling us to gather what was scattered from its sides, and to bring close what was distant from its corners.
And the resolve was established, as we stipulated at the beginning, to leave blank pages at the end of every chapter,
for capturing the stray [narrations], and incorporating the incoming [material],
and whatever may appear to us after obscurity, and fall into our hands after rarity,
And our success is not except through Allah. In Him we trust, and He is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
ai.seo_question: What is the compiler's purpose in leaving blank pages in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi concludes his compilation by expressing gratitude for the successful collection of Imam Ali’s scattered sayings, highlighting his methodological rigor in leaving blank pages to accommodate future discoveries or corrections. This practice underscores the dynamic nature of Shia hadith scholarship, where the text is viewed as an evolving repository of wisdom rather than a static artifact. It reflects the scholarly humility and reliance on divine assistance (tawakkul) essential to preserving the authenticity of the Imam's teachings.

en.sayed-ali-raza: This is the end of our selection of the utterances of Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him,

We are praiseful to Allāh, the Glorified, for having enabled us to collect the scattered utterances from various sides and to bring together from different places the material that was lying far away.
We intend, as we stipulated in the beginning, to leave some blank pages at the end of every chapter
for the insertion of whatever we may get
and the addition of whatever comes to us, for it is possible that some material which is not in our view at present or which is not available may become known to us and fall in our hands.
We have no ability save through Allāh. In Him we trust, and He is Sufficient for us. He is the best Supporter.
